description: NDP Part 2: Network Scenario Headroom Report SPM is a dataset listed in SP Energy Networks open data portal, an open data portal of an electricity network operator, published or maintained by SP Energy Networks. The " NDP Part 2: Network Scenario Headroom Report SPM " data table forecasts post-intervention headroom across all network groups out to 2050. This post-intervention headroom is calculated by combining existing network models, scenario forecasts, and known intervention plans. Coverage: Great Britain (network area of the operator or portal owner). The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Future Networks. Its keywords are Network Development Plan, NSHR, Constraint, Forecast, SPM, NDP. The portal shows 2026-08-24 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.en). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-spen-open-data-portal.
